subject.title: feat(gateway): present system-agent setup QR codes

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `system-agent-qr-code` as a Gateway client capability, including an optional `qrDataUrl` result and an explicit session reset when that capability changes?
rationale: This is a new cross-client public protocol and recovery contract, not a mechanical bug fix; implementation correctness cannot decide the long-term client compatibility and UX policy.

options.title: Accept the additive QR contract
options.body: Approve the capability-negotiated result field and reset-on-capability-change behavior as the supported Gateway path for future setup producers and clients.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Ask for a smaller owner-defined presentation seam or different reconnect behavior before exposing a durable Gateway capability.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Pause the PR until a production setup flow and broader client adoption plan justify the new protocol contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive QR contract
recommendation.body: Approve the capability-negotiated result field and reset-on-capability-change behavior as the supported Gateway path for future setup producers and clients.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this member as the active contributor across the Gateway, wizard, and Control UI design; owner review should include the protocol area’s established decision-makers if they differ.
